title: Pokémon Go ‘A Dazzling Aria’ Masterwork Research tasks and rewards so far
summary: The "A Dazzling Aria" Masterwork Research in Pokémon Go offers a chance at a shiny Meloetta and a range of rewards, including legendary candy, avatar items and rare resources. Tickets cost $5 and were available for a limited week-long window. The tasks are time-consuming and designed to be completed over days or weeks, but for regular players the rewards make the ticket worthwhile.
content:
Your chance to get a shiny Meloetta… eventually

The "A Dazzling Aria" Masterwork Research is your opportunity to get a shiny Meloetta in Pokémon Go.

Debuting alongside Go Tour: Unova, you have between Monday, Feb. 24, at 10 a.m. and Sunday, March 2, at 8 p.m. local time to purchase a ticket for $5 (or the local currency equivalent).

You can then find the Masterwork Research in the Special Research tab, where you can take as much time as you need to complete every task — which, given the nature of the challenges, makes it a necessity.

As such, not every step has been revealed to players — but here are the "A Dazzling Aria" research steps available so far in Pokémon Go, as well as whether purchasing "A Dazzling Aria" is worth it.

Update (April 23): We’ve added the final steps of the "A Dazzling Aria" research.

Once you’ve started the "A Dazzling Aria" Masterwork Research, there is no time limit to completing the following steps:

Rewards: 10x Reshiram candy, 10x Zekrom candy, Shiny Meloetta avatar T-shirt

Rewards: 1 Incense, 30 Ultra Balls, 1 XL candy

Rewards: 1 Incense, 30 Ultra Balls, 1 XL candy

Thanks 8BD0 on The Silph Road subreddit for providing details on the above.

Rewards: 1 Incense, 5 Golden Razz Berries, 5 Silver Pinap Berries

Rewards: Darmanitan encounter, 10 Darumaka Candy

Rewards: 4,920 XP, shiny Meloetta encounter

You’ll need to catch 100 unique Pokémon from the Unova region to get the gold Unova medal.

Rewards: 6,480 XP, 6,480 Stardust

Thanks Leek Duck for providing details on the above.

Though we don’t know the exact structure of the Masterwork Research, the following has been confirmed by Niantic as being part of the ticket.

Though it’s hard to put a shop value on many of the above items as they aren’t for sale, for $5 (or the local currency equivalent) this ticket seems like good value when broken down — there’s a shiny mythical and related avatar item you’re unlikely to get anywhere else, the reward of legendary Pokémon candy, some XL candy, and a handful of rare items that, for us, justify the price of entry.

The stumbling block, however, is the steep requirements to completing the Masterwork Research. These tickets are renowned for having challenges which are designed to take days, weeks, and even months to complete — whether it’s because they are time gated, or have steps which are designed to be chipped away at over a long period of time — so know you won’t get the above rewards quickly.

For players who will check in daily, however, this shouldn’t be a problem, and the marathon requirements to complete the ticket could actually be attractive for those looking for a goal to work towards long since Go Tour: Unova has concluded.

Either way, you only have a week to purchase the ticket and start the quest — so be sure to make a decision sooner than later!
